title: Observation of Universal Quantum Chaos at Shallow Depths
summary: Universal statistical laws are a hallmark of quantum chaos. A natural route to probing them in quantum circuits is offered by the statistics of output probabilities, which for sufficiently deep chaotic circuits approach the Porter--Thomas distribution. Here we show, theoretically and experimentally, that the approach to this limit is itself universal, and is organized into geometry-dependent universality classes.
